metadata.title: LOC पर आदिवासी जश्न | Tribal Village Life On LOC | Main Bhi Bharat | Gurez Valley
metadata.description:
On the LOC, Kashmir’s last village — where tribal songs echoed for the first time, mountains danced, and the Dard-Shin culture came alive again!
Amid centuries-old traditions, snow, and the challenges of life on the border, how did hope return to the faces of these brave people? Watch our special report from the breathtaking Gurez Valley.
